paragraphs.text:
After so many days on the river and nights in the woods, it feels 
strange to sit in a stifling room and answer questions about 
your conduct.

If you have lost any members of your party or have confirmed their 
death, multiply the number of such losses by 15. This is your Liability 
Score. Roll 1D100: if the result is greater than your liability score, 
go to 530; if the result is equal or less to your liability score, go to 531.
